final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS oi, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS ap, AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS ar FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items o ON o.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders r ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), s2 AS (SELECT town, AVG(ap) AS ap, AVG(ar) AS ar FROM s1 GROUP BY town), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS a FROM s2) SELECT s2.town, s2.ap, s2.ar, s2.ar - s3.a FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.ar > s3.a
